      Paste a public Spotify playlist. Its tracks become the song pool and the full list of accepted guesses.

      Press play, then choose a track. Every miss unlocks more of the signal: 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, then 16 seconds. Solve it, hit next track, and keep your streak alive.

      You start with 8 health. Solving on the 0.5s clip heals +1 (capped at 8); 1s is neutral; every longer clip costs one more, down to −4 at 16s. Letting a track beat you entirely is an instant wipeout. At 0 health the run ends — hit restart for a fresh session with full health.

      A yellow ARTIST or ALBUM marker means your guess shares that detail with the answer.

      Track information and previews are matched from Deezer. Tracks without a playable Deezer preview are skipped.
